competitionsData.title: PROJECT EXPO
competitionsData.description: Built something? Let the world see it. Bring it to Drishti '26 Project Expo.

competitionsData.title: D-SOLVE HACKATHON
competitionsData.description: Our flagship hackathon organized by Drishti'26 x CS Association, where ideas are weaponised into prototypes and 3 AM debugging sessions become part of the story.
guidelines: One ticket per team: Each team must have one registration ticket.
Same institution: All team members must belong to the same college/institution; no inter-college teams.
One team only: Each participant can register/participate in only one team.
No team changes: Team members cannot be changed after registration.
details: Open to : All undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.

competitionsData.title: Robo Wars
competitionsData.description: Build and battle ferocious combat robots in an armored arena. Push your engineering and driving skills to the absolute limit in high-octane mechanical warfare.
eligibility: Open to undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
Teams may consist of 2 to 4 members with valid college ID proof.
Participants must be comfortable with hardware assembly and safety protocols.
guidelines: Each bot must pass a safety inspection before arena entry.
Judging is based on aggression, damage control, weapon reliability and strategy.
Final round will be held on 20 September 2026.
details: Open to : All undergraduate and postgraduate engineering students.
Arena Safety : Fully enclosed polycarbonate arena with hazard zones.
Evaluation : Aggression · Damage · Control · Arena Hazards.
Prizes : Exciting cash prizes & sponsor swags for top 3 bots.
